```{r setup, include=FALSE}

## Set global chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.height = 5, fig.width = 8, 
                      cache = FALSE,
                      cache.lazy = FALSE)

#Load required libraries

install.packages('fastmap')
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("igraph")
install.packages("visNetwork")



## Load packages
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
p_load("dplyr", 'tidyverse',"fastmap","ggplot2", "readxl",'writexl', 'stringr',
       "fitdistrplus","gplots", "reshape2", "colorspace","purrr",
       "readr","ggrepel", "treemap", 'tidyverse', 'igraph', 'visNetwork', 'ggraph')


```

```{R set wd}
setwd("wd")
```

```{R Load data and convert to long}
#load datasets
data <- read_excel("Database.xlsx")

# Convert the data into long format
library(tidyr)
data_long <- data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(res_man, ecotox, beneficial), 
               names_to = "Category", 
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  filter(Value == "x") # Only keep rows where the value is "x"
```

##VOS viewer analysis

```{r colored categories}
data_long_colors <- data_long %>%
  mutate(
    red = case_when(
      Category == "res_man"    ~ 87,
      Category == "ecotox"     ~ 169,
      Category == "beneficial" ~ 240,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    green = case_when(
      Category == "res_man"    ~ 100,
      Category == "ecotox"     ~ 59,
      Category == "beneficial" ~ 228,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    blue = case_when(
      Category == "res_man"    ~ 174,
      Category == "ecotox"     ~ 150,
      Category == "beneficial" ~ 66,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

library(readr)
```

```{R map data}

map_data <- read_tsv(
  "document map.txt",
  col_names = TRUE,
  comment = "#"
)

map_data <- map_data %>%
  mutate(
    DOI = sub("^.*doi\\.org/", "", url)
  )


map_data_merged <- map_data %>%
  left_join(
    data_long_colors,
    by = "DOI"
  )

table(map_data_merged$Category, useNA = "ifany")
na_table <- map_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(Category))

merge_NA <- data_long_colors %>%
  left_join(
    map_data_merged,
    by = "DOI"
  )

map_data_merged %>%
  count(Category, red, green, blue)

map_final <- map_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    label,
    x,
    y,
    red,
    green,
    blue)

write.table(
  map_final,
  "VOSviewer_custom_colors.map",
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

head(map_final)

```

##Summary database

```{R bar plots ADME}
# Plot ADME 

adme_counts <- data_long %>%
  group_by(Category, ADME) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Define colors
adme_colors <- c(
  "Absorption" = "#56B4E9",
  "Distribution" = "#D55E00",
  "Metabolism" = "#009E73",
  "Excretion" = "#F0E442",
  "Bioaccumulation" = "#CC79A7"
)

# Grouped bar plot
ADME_plot <- ggplot(adme_counts, aes(x = Category, y = n, fill = ADME)) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = adme_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Category",
    y = "Number of studies",
    fill = "ADME Process"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16), 
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
ggsave("...\\ADME_plot.pdf", plot = ADME_plot, width = 7, height = 5)
```

##Network analysis

```{R}
#Subsets category
ecotox_db <- data_long %>%
  filter(Category == "ecotox")
res_man_db <- data_long %>%
  filter(Category == "res_man")
beneficial_db <- data_long %>%
  filter(Category == "beneficial")

#convert to long 
ADME_output_ecotox <- ecotox_db %>%
  separate_rows(ADME, sep = ",\\s*")
method_output_ecotox <- ADME_output_ecotox %>%

ADME_output_beneficial <- beneficial_db %>%

method_output_beneficial <- ADME_output_beneficial %>%
```

```{R network analysis}

#determine frequency of keywords within each group
method_network <- merged_ecotox
data_network <- method_network %>% 
  dplyr::select(ID, ADME, method) 

method_frequency <- data_network %>%
  count(method, name = "total_count")

frequent_methods <- method_frequency %>%
  filter(total_count > 0)
unique(method_network$method)

#create co-occurrence pairs
pairs_network <- data_network %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(method = list(method), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pairs = map(method, ~ {
    kw <- unique(.x)
    if (length(kw) < 2) return(NULL)
    df <- as.data.frame(t(combn(kw, 2)))
    names(df) <- c("Method1", "Method2")
    df
  })) %>%
  filter(!map_lgl(pairs, is.null)) %>%
  unnest(pairs) %>%
  count(Method1, Method2, name = "weight")

#Merge the frequency information with the co-occurrence data
freq_network <- pairs_network %>%
  left_join(method_frequency, by = c("Method1" = "method")) %>%
  rename(total_count_1 = total_count) %>%
  left_join(method_frequency, by = c("Method2" = "method")) %>%
  rename(total_count_2 = total_count)


edges <- freq_network %>%
  rename(from = Method1, to = Method2) %>%
  filter(from %in% frequent_methods$method,
         to   %in% frequent_methods$method)

nodes <- data_network %>%
  distinct(method, ADME) %>%
  rename(name = method) %>%
  filter(name %in% frequent_methods$method)

# Create the graph object
network <- graph_from_data_frame(d = edges, vertices = nodes, directed = FALSE)

#Add centrality of the nodes
# Calculate centrality (e.g., degree centrality) for node sizes
V(network)$centrality <- degree(network, mode = "all")  # Degree centrality

# Convert igraph object to a data frame for centrality mapping
node_data <- data.frame(
  name = V(network)$name,
  centrality = V(network)$centrality
)

nodes <- nodes %>%
  left_join(node_data, by = "name")

# Visualization
network_plot2 <- ggraph(network, layout = "fr") +
  
  # Edge properties
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(edge_width = weight),
    alpha = 0.5,            # Reduced opacity for better readability
    color = "grey60",       # Standardized edge color
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Node properties
  geom_node_point(
    aes(size = centrality),
    color = "#CC79A7",
    #color = "#C95500",
    alpha = 1,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Node labels
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    label.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    label.size = 0.2,
    family = "sans",
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    force = 10,                  # Increased repulsion force
    max.overlaps = Inf,          # Ensure all labels are shown
    min.segment.length = 0,      # Allow shorter segments
    point.padding = unit(1, "lines"),
    box.padding = unit(1, "lines")
  ) +
  
  # Scale adjustments
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.3, 2.5)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 12), guide = "none") +  # Remove size legend
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  
  # Theme customization
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )
print(network_plot2)
metabolism_plot <- network_plot2

# Save plot
ggsave("...\\metabolism_ecotox.pdf", plot = metabolism_plot, width = 7, height = 5)

```

##Extra figures

```{R Plot network combined non target}

# 1. Define nodes to highlight
highlight_nodes <- c(
  "Phylogenetic analysis",
  "Chromatin analysis",
  "Heterologous expression",
  "Recombinant assay",
  "In vitro metabolism",
  "Penetration assay",
  "Histology"
)
#highlight_nodes <- c("Metabolite analysis","Tissue accumulation", "Genomic analysis","Enzymatic activity","Oxygen consumption")


# 2. Add highlight column to network
V(network)$highlight <- ifelse(V(network)$name %in% highlight_nodes,
                              "Unique method",
                              "Common method")

# 3. Plot
network_plot2 <- ggraph(network, layout = "fr") +
  
  # Edges
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(edge_width = weight),
    alpha = 0.5,
    color = "grey60",
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Nodes (UPDATED COLOR MAPPING)
  geom_node_point(
    aes(color = highlight, size = centrality),
    alpha = 1,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  geom_node_text(
    aes(label = name),
    repel = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    label.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    label.size = 0.2,
    family = "Arial",
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black",
    force = 10,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    point.padding = unit(1, "lines"),
    box.padding = unit(1, "lines")
  ) +
  
  # Scales
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.3, 2.5)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(4, 12), guide = "none") +
  
  # 🔴🔵 Manual colors
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
        "Common method" = "#9370DB",  # purple
  "Unique method" = "#D55E00"   # vermillion
    )
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, "cm"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Methods to Measure Metabolism in Non-Target Invertebrates",
    subtitle = "Including beneficial arthropod studies, Co-occurrence Network",
    color = "node type"
  ) +
theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
)

print(network_plot2)

```
